# CodeArena product reference

CodeArena helps developers build skill together. Members can practice coding, SQL, and prompting solo; match with other developers for live coding or prompt battles; challenge friends directly; rematch opponents; join human tournaments and weekly challenges; climb rankings; and review their activity and battle history.

The social layer includes public profiles, friends, messages, online presence, and notifications. CreatorArena lets members create coding games, while the Gallery lets the community discover and play them.
